needed.evidence: No footway provided, pedestrians must walk in the road
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous and usable physical barrier or sidewalk along the left side of the road to protect pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Sidewalk obstructed by trees and other potential trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Clear the narrow sidewalk on the right side of encroaching obstacles to ensure it is fully usable.

needed.evidence: Uneven surfaces and potential trip hazards on the right sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the uneven sections of the right-side footway to ensure pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: Crossing is not clearly marked and drivers may not stop
needed.suggestion: Install well-marked zebra crossings with additional signage and traffic-signalling to improve visibility and ensure drivers will stop.

needed.evidence: Lack of kerb ramps for accessibility at the marked crossing
needed.suggestion: Provide kerb ramps at the crossing to aid accessibility for pedestrians, including those with disabilities.

needed.evidence: Insufficient street lighting along this urban road
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights to ensure ample lighting along the entire urban road stretch.
